mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has risen in each of the last three weeks (-14.6 to -13.0), indicating a steady return to in-person work routines that generates incidental weekday retail and recreation visits, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES increased monotonically over the last 3 weekly observations
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days despite WORKPLACES continuing to improve week over week.

failure_condition: TRANSIT stalls or reverses below -38 in the next two weeks while RETAIL_REC still rises, or TRANSIT crosses -35 but RETAIL_REC does not increase.

failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL and WORKPLACES continue their joint trend but RETAIL_REC does not rise, or the two series decouple (one reverses) without RETAIL_REC declining.

mechanism_narrative: Under a regime of gradual restriction easing, the combination of improving WORKPLACES, declining RESIDENTIAL, and flat GROCERY_PHARM reflects policy-driven expansion of permitted activity that should continue raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks, absent new restriction announcements.
